stem: Sensor West is at $A(-4, 2)$ and Sensor East is at $B(9, 2)$ on a grid where $x$ is the distance from the research station and $y$ is the sea-surface height. Draw the straight-line boundary connecting the two sensors. Drag the two points so the line is that boundary.

hints.text: The sensors differ in distance but not in height. Think which direction the line runs.
Every point on the boundary has the sensors' height. Check where your line meets the y-axis.
Compare the y-coordinates of the two sensors.

notes: Grid widened so B (9,2) is on the board.
